g.text: • Leave out passages with text addressed to the assistant
• No passages left: 0 claims, model not called
• ≤ 6 claims, one fact per complete sentence; cite exact IDs;
• Qwen3 4B via Ollama: temperature 0, JSON schema,
• Strip <think> tags and markdown fences; Pydantic
• Reply cut off: keep every complete claim, drop the
• Nothing recoverable: retry once with a stricter prompt,
DraftAnswer: list of Claim (text + citation IDs)
• Citation not among the retrieved passages: repaired if it
names a clause inside exactly one retrieved section;
• Remaining citations resolved to their chunk text
• Claim left with no citation: NEUTRAL, score 0
Per claim: cited evidence chunks · 'fabricated' list
Claim + its evidence go to NLI and numeric checks
Claim (hypothesis) + each cited chunk, its section heading in front (premise)
• Claim quoted word for word in the passage: entailment, no model needed
• Premise split into sentences + runs of 2–3 sentences (SummaC); table
rows and list items as their own units
• DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli on CPU, batched; any unit with
entailment ≥ 0.5 supports; else contradiction ≥ 0.5; else strongest signal
NLIResult: label + probabilities + the deciding sentence
Results for every cited chunk go to verify_claim()
• Regex finds numbers: 75%, "75 %", 1,200, 3.5 and clock times (7:30 pm)
• Every claim number must appear in the evidence; % must match %, a time
NumericCheck: ok + detail, e.g. "claim states 90%, evidence has 75%"
Result goes to verify_claim(); it can veto support, never grant it
• Entailment ≥ 0.5 in any cited chunk: SUPPORTED, score = entailment
• … but numbers mismatch, or another cited section contradicts (≥ 0.9):
ClaimVerdict: status, score, evidence, check details, explanation
All verdicts go to the relevance gate
• Cosine similarity question ↔ claim (bge): best ≥ 0.85 on topic, < 0.55 off
• In between: Qwen asked once, yes/no (JSON): does a claim answer the
• Judge fails: similarity ≥ 0.60 decides, and the answer is flagged
Each claim marked relevant / not relevant
• Abstain if no passages were retrieved, or the model produced no claims
• Keep claims that are SUPPORTED, score ≥ 0.5 and relevant; all others move to 'removed' and are shown with their
• Abstain if no claim is kept; the reason says contradicted, unverified or not in the policies
Answer: claims kept, claims removed, abstained, reason, per-stage timings, config fingerprint
Shown in the Streamlit app (app.py) and scripts/ask.py
each claim + its cited evidence chunks
